acceptanceCriteria: Cases 21 and 22 are executed under Go 1.24.13 for the portable verifier and the result is retained.
The stable lifecycle tests are executed on Linux and the result is retained, or Linux is recorded as an explicit exclusion.
Results that remain unexecuted stay NOT_RUN in the build log.
body:
Test gap observed 2026-10-01 while integrating the public S0E repository-envelope packet (repair 6, manifest sha256 21655c5d73a4b9b9af9f91e6dacbf702a8d2f95cdc9b40368a4cc240dedbd535; beamfall/corvint#471).

On Darwin arm64 with Go 1.27.1 both the portable verifier (interop/cem01-go) and the private native overlay run 54 of 56 full-result cases; cases 21 (go1.24.13-nonstructural-positive) and 22 (go1.24.13-structural-refusal) skip because they run only under go1.24.13. Linux lifecycle, cross-device topology and escaped-session behaviour were not executed; GOOS=linux and GOOS=windows go vet is compile evidence only.

Expected: every packet case and the lifecycle suite have an observed result on each claimed platform/toolchain. Actual: NOT_RUN for the items above.

2026-10-02 qualification observation: unchanged published native source d5fdbe733b5bfbc0ff3c5a2aa2d1cc195bb8e0d2 now has an actual Linux arm64 negative result, not a qualification pass. The default group owner HOLDs on an exited unreaped zombie-only group because signal0 succeeds; bare stable verification returns repository/unsupported-process-containment exit2 after20.157s. Runtime defect filed separately as V1-0668 (receipt1893). Hosted Linux amd64 has six similarly timed repository refusals, but exact codes in the original pointer-formatted test logs remain NOT_OBSERVED; fresh scalar diagnostics and actual amd64 platform qualification are still required. Independent fixture author identity defect is V1-0667 (receipt1892). Do not replace the remaining matrix with this single controlled arm64 probe or skip failed platform cases. Diagnostic evidence /private/tmp/cem10-codex-control/pr476-linux-readonly-diag/. No source repair or new review loop; original2-cycle limit and batch scope serialization preserved.

2026-10-02 repaired qualification observation: genuine V1-0668 claim127 receipt1947 admitted one additional repair expressly authorized by the human. Exact12path source received fresh independent source review PASS (ADDITIONAL-FINAL-ROOT-REVIEW.md), committed1a355ea551c2745d3fe9f229a36acc348cb205d8 tree7d34fba6882a4b7cbbec1f0ef678ede962d8bc96, identical to reviewed/qualified scratch94a0fa323fc82c199873168acaebcc8da21a3a42. Actual Linux arm64 Go1.27.1/git2.47.3/kernel6.8 five scoped packages pass in split source/binary-bound runs; new Owner Linux controls and original fixed-clock gitrun positive pass. Joined evidence LINUX-ARM64-QUALIFICATION-JOINED.json retains each actual result and all skips. First harness failed because /tmp tmpfs did not permit generated executable scripts, causing pinned executable refusal and fake-PATH negative/counting controls to bypass wrappers. Explicit exec mount and executable probe resolved those failures without source edits. Second harness failed only because immutable legacy interop/cem-0.1/conformance/cem-0.1 fixtures were omitted; adding those exact snapshot directories resolved verifier/candidate tests. Both initial failed runs remain failed and retained, all three exact owned containers/controllers retired. This is observed qualification harness friction, deduplicated into this existing test gap; future qualification must retain temporary execution prerequisites and exact fixture closure. Existing Darwin-only full S0E and linked-control tests still skip on Linux, so full raw21-field Linux public matrix is NOT_RUN, not implied by aggregate package PASS. A separately authorized private additive diagnostic snapshot bd1acb40ec8ef7297856b1c04190482e90614c7a adds only a Linux full-result driver that invokes unchanged packet/recipes/comparator for56 cases; preparation only, execution awaits root inspection. 54 requireGo1.27.1; two Go1.24.13 cases remain NOT_RUN. Actual Linux amd64, cross-device, escaped-session, external/default/release/integration/native completion remain pending. This ticket stays OPEN; original source/negative evidence preserved. Core1.0.0-rc.1 build163 and Tasks build202 official current channels observed, publisher identity NOT_VERIFIED; no broad tool qualification inferred.

2026-10-02 final native Linux arm64 observation: after root readback of the private additive diagnostic driver, the unchanged 56-case public packet was executed on actual Linux arm64 Go 1.27.1, Git 2.47.3, kernel 6.8.0-117. All 54 Go 1.27.1 cases PASS; both Go 1.24.13 cases explicitly NOT_RUN; zero failures. Every executed case compares all 21 result fields recursively and field-for-field with its complete frozen expected object, with no runtime or envelope normalization. LINUX-FULL-RESULT-QUALIFICATION.json and LINUX-FULL-RESULT-ACTUAL.jsonl retain these observations. The private diagnostic commit bd1acb40ec8ef7297856b1c04190482e90614c7a adds only the driver to reviewed snapshot 94a0fa323fc82c199873168acaebcc8da21a3a42; product commit 1a355ea551c2745d3fe9f229a36acc348cb205d8 has the identical reviewed tree 7d34fba6882a4b7cbbec1f0ef678ede962d8bc96. Diagnostic test binary SHA256 52ecb56e21ea718f10c8169f5ff07ff78b345bdb0a7df9c9017af7b741649c84 is separately retained and is not a product source commit. Strict fixture-local author identity also passes actual Linux with author environment unset and global/system Git configuration disabled; FIXTURE-IDENTITY-LINUX.json retains this independent observation. All owned controllers and exact containers are absent. Genuine source phase 127 released with receipt 1963, readback CANCELLED/FENCED and audit CONSISTENT/AGREES. Final enrolled checks, registry/CEM binding, integration and native completion have not run. Actual Linux amd64, portable standalone Linux, Go 1.24.13, cross-device/escaped-session behavior, external adoption, default promotion and release readiness remain distinct pending outcomes. No prior failed run, historical source or sealed evidence was rewritten. This ticket remains OPEN.

2026-10-02 portable historical-floor cases now executed on actual Darwin arm64 Go 1.24.13 at immutable product source 1a355ea551c2745d3fe9f229a36acc348cb205d8. Original TestStableCanonicalFullResults selected only cases 21 and 22. Both RUN_REAL and PASS: nonstructural positive exit 0; structural refusal exit 2. Unchanged original comparator compared every one of the 21 result fields to the frozen expected objects; no runtime/envelope replacement. GO124-TWO-CASE-QUALIFICATION.json and go124-two-case-qualification/{tests.log,conformance.json,binding.json} retain exact results and source/packet binding. Existing official task-local archive SHA256 f282d882c3353485e2fc6c634606d85caf36e855167d59b996dbeae19fa7629a, 76442495 bytes, freshly matched retained official manifest; all 14,179 extracted regular files matched archive and license retained. No global installation, PATH configuration change, toolchain downgrade or download. Child-only compiler binding, private cache/temp, GOTOOLCHAIN=local and downloads disabled. Genuine qualification generation 131 receipt 1969 held declared docs/ and interop/cem01-go/ plus both truthful OTHER resources; safely released receipt 1970, readback CANCELLED/FENCED, audit CONSISTENT/AGREES. Exact owned keeper/test child absent; escaped sessions remain excluded from that wrapper audit. This satisfies the original two-case portable compatibility execution criterion on Darwin; it does not qualify Core on Go 1.24, Linux on Go 1.24, portable standalone Linux or all 56 cases on one platform. Earlier NOT_RUN observations remain historical and superseded only for these two actual Darwin cases. Native Linux Go 1.27.1 54-case PASS remains separate. Final build-log/CEM integration and native completion are pending; ticket remains OPEN.
title: Run the S0E packet cases that are NOT_RUN: Go 1.24.13 cases 21-22 and Linux lifecycle
